name: Anvil
author: E. T. Carter
description: A night storm line over a flooded plain: a broad blue-green tower left, a gold-lit cell and a pale blue cell deeper right, all merging into a coral-lit canopy, with a rose glow on the far horizon. Lights climb and swell inside the billowing cells in staggered turns, scud and rain drift under the bases, and the chopped flood mirrors the glows past a reed clump on a black bank in the near corner.

params.label: Interior glow
params.effect: Brightness of the lights travelling inside the storm cells.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Pace of the boiling billows, racing scud and wandering lights.

params.label: Rain curtains
params.effect: Density of the rain hanging under the cell bases.

params.label: Wind chop
params.effect: From a glassy mirror to broken streaks of reflected glow on the flood.
